diagnosis_accuracy.adaptation: catalog and explicit alias matching; current demo reads gold labels

ntcr.adaptation: micro ratio of unique required completed tests

uti.adaptation: nonrecommended completed test events / required Perform tests

ucr.adaptation: actual consult-start events; no consultations is NA

camr.document_reference: Ruhrberg Estevez et al. (2026), process-safety concept
camr.adaptation: explicit critical-action events and optional deadline; not a quoted standardized metric

apl.adaptation: recorded clinical actions, excluding movement/resource events

ttd.adaptation: final diagnosis minus arrival; completed cohort with censoring flags

dber.document_reference: Luo et al. (2026), temporal deterioration concept
dber.adaptation: strictly earlier deterioration / labelled at-risk patients

wte.adaptation: 1 - CPWT/MWT; missing labels or zero denominator is NA

priority.adaptation: weighted severity/wait/risk with critical-priority guard; uncalibrated weights

deterioration.adaptation: explicit thresholds; no inferred clinical cutoffs
